capabilities: Display and edit frontmatter properties in configurable in-note panels
Build select and multi-select options from static lists, other notes' frontmatter, Markdown lists, or folder contents
Apply different panels and layouts to notes matching folder, tag, or wikilink rules
Arrange fields in responsive grids, nested groups, and multiple label positions
Customize panel and field appearance through Style Settings
extras: README discloses the plugin was created entirely by AI without complete human code review and recommends testing in a separate vault with backups; placement of panels near Properties and Linked Mentions relies on DOM selectors that may break after Obsidian updates. An examples folder ships complete book-card configurations.
intentEvidence: Display and edit Obsidian frontmatter properties in configurable panels that stay inside the note's scrollable content.
problem: Obsidian's Properties view offers only fixed inline editing, so users cannot build custom visual metadata forms for selected notes without writing code.

relations.evidence: When Style Settings is installed, controls are grouped into Panel, Field, Select, Rating and Progress, and Multi-select sections.

summary: Visual panel editor that displays and edits frontmatter properties in configurable panels embedded in the note's scrollable content.
